title: Recalculating the Cleaning Charge on a Security Deposit Account Statement
content:
When a cleaning charge on a Security Deposit Account final account statement is corrected, the dispute credit is the difference between what was charged for cleaning and the corrected cleaning charge.

## The calculation

1. **Cleaning charged.** The cleaning charged is the sum of the amounts of every cleaning line itemized on the account. This includes the whole-unit cleaning line and every spot-cleaning line of a room alike.
2. **Corrected cleaning charge.** The corrected cleaning charge is the whole-unit cleaning charge plus the spot-cleaning rate for each room that carries a spot-cleaning line, rounded half up to the cent. A room carries a spot-cleaning line when a cleaning line is itemized for that room rather than for the whole unit.
3. **Whole-unit cleaning charge.** This is the cleaning rate of the lease's floor plan:

| Floor plan (smallest to largest) | Cleaning rate (USD) |
|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 125.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 150.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 165.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 195.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 235.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | 295.00 |

4. **Spot-cleaning rate.** This is the program's carpet spot-cleaning charge per room, taken from the program's move-out charge figures.
5. **Dispute credit.** The dispute credit is the cleaning charged less the corrected cleaning charge, rounded half up to the cent.

The floor plan is read from the Apartment Home Lease. The cleaning lines, and the room each one is itemized for, are read from the account's itemized move-out lines.

## Worked example (hypothetical statement)

A Two-Bedroom Residence account carries a whole-unit cleaning line of 240.00 USD and spot-cleaning lines for two rooms of 70.00 USD each. Take the program's per-room spot-cleaning charge as a hypothetical 45.00 USD.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Cleaning charged: 240.00 plus 70.00 plus 70.00 | 380.00 |
| Whole-unit cleaning charge (Two-Bedroom Residence) | 195.00 |
| Spot-cleaning: two rooms times 45.00 | 90.00 |
| Corrected cleaning charge: 195.00 plus 90.00 | 285.00 |
| Dispute credit: 380.00 less 285.00 | 95.00 |

## Second example (hypothetical, no spot lines)

A Studio Residence account carries one whole-unit cleaning line of 160.00 USD and no room lines. The corrected cleaning charge is 125.00 USD, and the dispute credit is 160.00 less 125.00, which is 35.00 USD.
